mapper.select: SELECT id, api_code, batch_number, close_date FROM b_marketing_task WHERE STATUS = 1 AND monitor_status = 1 AND close_date <= #{1} AND close_date > curdate() AND monitor_type in (2, 3, 4)
SELECT id, api_code, batch_number, close_date FROM b_marketing_task WHERE STATUS = 1 AND monitor_status = 1 AND close_date = #{1} AND monitor_type in (2, 3, 4)
select * from b_marketing_task where create_time > date_add(curdate(), interval -1 day) and create_time < curdate()
SELECT * FROM b_marketing_task WHERE cus_batch = #{cusBatch} and status = 1
select cus_batch from b_marketing_task where api_code = #{apiCode} and status = 1 group by cus_batch

SELECT a.cus_batch FROM b_marketing_task a, stra_his_file b WHERE a.batch_number = b.batch_number AND a.api_code = #{apiCode} AND a.monitor_status = 1 AND a.cus_batch <> '' AND b.create_time > curdate() AND b.STATUS IN (0, 2) GROUP BY a.cus_batch;

SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, increment, is_check, monitor_model, close_date, file_name, cus_batch FROM b_marketing_task WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} AND monitor_status = 1
SELECT api_code FROM b_marketing_task WHERE monitor_status = 1 AND `status` = 1 AND start_date <= now() AND close_date >= now() group by api_code

SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, increment, is_check, monitor_model, close_date FROM b_marketing_task_3005390 WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} AND monitor_status = 1 AND `status` = 1 AND start_date <= now() AND close_date >= now() GROUP BY batch_number

SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, monitor_type, close_date, cus_batch, file_name, actual_number, is_repair, context_id, cycle_day, task_type, product_info FROM b_marketing_task WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} AND monitor_status = 1 AND `status` = 1 AND start_date <= now() AND close_date >= now()

SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, increment, is_check, monitor_model, close_date FROM b_marketing_task WHERE api_code <> '3004761' AND monitor_status = 1 AND `status` = 1 AND start_date <= now() AND close_date >= now() GROUP BY batch_number

SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, increment, is_check, monitor_model, close_date, file_name, monitor_status, monitor_type, actual_number, task_number, is_repair, context_id, task_type, product_info, is_online, score_separator FROM b_marketing_task WHERE batch_number = #{batchNumber}
SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, increment, is_check, monitor_model, close_date FROM b_marketing_task WHERE monitor_status = 1 AND `status` = 1

SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, increment, is_check, monitor_model, close_date, create_time FROM b_marketing_task WHERE monitor_status > 0 AND ( is_check = 0 OR is_check is NULL )

SELECT id, batch_number, api_code, strategy_id, frequency, start_date, monitor_type, close_date, file_name, actual_number FROM b_marketing_task WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} AND `status` = 1 GROUP BY batch_number
mapper.update: UPDATE b_marketing_task SET status=#{status}, task_number=#{taskNumber}, actual_number=#{actualNumber}, strategy_id =#{strategyId}, strategy_name =#{strategyName}, frequency =#{frequency}, start_date=#{startDate}, close_date =#{closeDate}, monitor_status=#{monitorStatus}, is_repair=#{isRepair} WHERE api_code = #{apiCode} AND batch_number = #{batchNumber}

UPDATE b_marketing_task SET strategy_id =#{strategyId}, strategy_name =#{strategyName}, frequency =#{frequency}, start_date=#{startDate}, close_date =#{closeDate}, update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE b_marketing_task SET strategy_id =#{strategyId}, strategy_name =#{strategyName}, frequency =#{frequency}, start_date=#{startDate}, close_date =#{closeDate}, update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE cus_batch = #{cusBatch} and status = 1
mapper.select: select * from b_marketing_task where api_code = #{apiCode} and monitor_type = 4 order by create_time asc limit 1
select id, product as `code` from b_apicode_score_product where api_code = #{apiCode} and is_del = 1 order by id desc;
select count(*) from b_marketing_task where status = 1 and priority = #{priority}

select bmt.id, shf.id as `hisFileId`, bmt.api_code, bmt.batch_number as `batchNumber`, bmt.task_number as `taskNumber`, bmt.monitor_type as `execType`, bmt.is_online as `isOnline` from b_marketing_task bmt left join stra_his_file shf on shf.batch_number = bmt.batch_number where shf.id = #{fileId} order by shf.create_time desc;
mapper.update: UPDATE b_marketing_task SET start_date = #{startDate}, close_date = #{closeDate}, update_time = now() WHERE batch_number = #{batchNumber}
